verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management/kanban tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-prem or installable edition of Trello. Every documented surface is the cloud service (developer.atlassian.com/cloud, 'sign-up, create a board'), and a community user explicitly asked for an installable version for internal use, which suggests none exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
